not_established: The loading is a probe chosen by this pipeline, not the author's own example. The meaning of the material constants is not certified. Parameter sensitivities and higher orders are not covered by a tangent check.
what_this_is: Every material in this collection passed Abaqus verification: the original and the OTI-converted build both ran in Abaqus on the same deck, their stress and state histories agreed, and the OTI tangent agreed with a finite difference of the ORIGINAL implementation at several states along the loading path. Compiling is not verification and is not what put anything here.
